title: Grandparent emergency scam
subtitle: 'Grandma, it's me — I'm in jail'
scenarioAdvice: Hang up and call your family member directly on their usual number. Real emergencies survive a callback.
explanation: This matches the known scam pattern 'Grandparent / emergency scam' (51% confidence). Main red flags: aggressive emotional tone and isolation tactics. Speaker A is running a pressure script (75/100). Do not act on anything this caller says. Hang up and verify independently.

evidence.speaker: A
evidence.quote: I was arrested last night and I need bail money right now. The lawyer says wire the money by courier before noon today, or I stay in jail over the weekend.
